input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
input.rationale: Governing law is Arizona, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), and Section 19 sends all disputes to mandatory binding arbitration under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules rather than to courts, with the only court role being confirmation of the award in the district of the party against whom it was entered. That fails both fallback elements (accepted law and a corresponding court forum). We therefore replace only the jurisdiction words in Section 11 with New York law and convert the Section 19 dispute mechanic into exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, renaming the heading so no dangling arbitration reference remains.

mappings.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.

proposal.summary: New York law; exclusive jurisdiction of New York County courts in place of mandatory arbitration
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have moved governing law from Arizona to New York and replaced the mandatory arbitration mechanic with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, per our governing-law position; Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: in accordance with the laws of the Arizona
ops.newText: in accordance with the laws of the State of New York

ops.oldText: will be subject to and resolved by binding arbitration pursuant to the Arbitration Rules of U.S. Arbitration & Mediation, (www.usam.com). Any award or order rendered by the arbitrator may be confirmed as a judgment or order in any state or federal court of competent jurisdiction, which includes within the federal judicial district of the residence of the party against whom such award or order was entered.
ops.newText: will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.
